title: November 2026 – The Pharma Letter
summary: Cambridge, USA-based Immuneering Corporation (Nasdaq: IMRX) today announced it has entered into a clinical trial collaboration and supply agreement with a subsidiary of Japan’s Astellas Pharma (TYO: 4503).
